chars.YOUNES: YOUNES: a slim Moroccan young man in his twenties with short curly black hair and a thin moustache, wearing a mustard-yellow hooded sweatshirt, olive green cargo trousers and white sneakers
chars.LARBI: LARBI: a stocky Moroccan young man in his twenties with a shaved head and short beard, wearing a red and black checkered flannel shirt over a grey t-shirt, dark blue jeans and brown work boots

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: At dusk behind a mud-brick farmhouse in a Moroccan douar, LARBI secretly unfolds an old torn yellowed treasure map while YOUNES leans close, both glancing around nervously, tense excited expressions. 2D flat cartoon illustration, vertical composition, main action in the centre, rural Moroccan countryside near a small douar, no text, no letters

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: YOUNES and LARBI walk quickly along a dry rocky riverbed (oued) at sunset carrying a pickaxe, two shovels and an oil lantern, looking over their shoulders. 2D flat cartoon illustration, vertical composition, main action in the centre, rural Moroccan countryside near a small douar, no text, no letters

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Under the moonlight in the dry riverbed next to two stacked marker stones, YOUNES swings a pickaxe into a deep hole and it strikes something hard with a spark, LARBI holding the lantern jumps back shocked, wide eyes. 2D flat cartoon illustration, vertical composition, main action in the centre, rural Moroccan countryside near a small douar, no text, no letters

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Night in the dry riverbed beside a fresh hole, LARBI points at his own chest angrily while YOUNES argues back pointing at the hole, the two friends face to face in open tension, lantern light. 2D flat cartoon illustration, vertical composition, main action in the centre, rural Moroccan countryside near a small douar, no text, no letters

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Night, YOUNES and LARBI dig frantically and greedily inside a deep hole, sweat on their faces, dirt flying, eyes shining with greed, lantern on the edge. 2D flat cartoon illustration, vertical composition, main action in the centre, rural Moroccan countryside near a small douar, no text, no letters

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Wide night view of the dry riverbed: tiny figures of YOUNES and LARBI digging by lantern light in the distance, while in the foreground a dark silhouette of a hooded stranger hides behind a big rock watching them, face hidden in shadow. 2D flat cartoon illustration, vertical composition, main action in the centre, rural Moroccan countryside near a small douar, no text, no letters

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Night, YOUNES and LARBI kneel at the edge of the deep hole pulling hard on a thick rope together, straining with effort, something heavy coming up from the dark. 2D flat cartoon illustration, vertical composition, main action in the centre, rural Moroccan countryside near a small douar, no text, no letters

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Night, a big old iron-bound wooden chest covered in dirt sits on the ground next to the hole, YOUNES and LARBI stare at it in amazement, lantern light glowing on the closed lid. 2D flat cartoon illustration, vertical composition, main action in the centre, rural Moroccan countryside near a small douar, no text, no letters
